3D Modelling 11.03.2007 1 min read

Canary Wharf Overview Movie

Andy CASA, UCL East

Movies are the obvious choice when you need to depict the urban environment, yet so often the real world is overlooked in favour of the virtual. Only last week we were asked to create a movie of London for a well known organisation using 3D modelling when a standard video capture would of portrayed the scene infinitely better.

The following movie depicts this point, its a simple travelogue by IDJ Media but ends up providing a good overview of the area - something that in 3D would of been a huge project:



Suffice to say that by recommending a 'real world' movie we lost out on any major 3D modelling work and they went out and brought a digital camera...
